**Group:** Trust and rights

### `seller-reply-reports`
- **Purpose:** record users' one-tap reports of what a seller said after they messaged them, and publish counts per listing.
- **Does / does not:** fixed codes only, from the owner's examples: collection was elsewhere, postage only, a bank transfer or deposit was asked for (`nabvy/docs/decisions.md:156`); the final codes and their wording are the owner's (question 43). No free text. One report per listing, reporter and code; rate-limited per user in the procedure; the account's standing is checked through `account`. Reporters are never shown to anyone (`nabvy/docs/decisions.md:158`). It publishes internal counts of distinct reporters and of distinct established reporters per listing and code; what counts as established is a starting rule to calibrate in shadow (question 43). The mark itself is `suspected-labels`' job and attaches to the listing, never the seller. This card is a placeholder until the too-good-to-be-true draft lands (`nabvy/docs/handoff.md:96`).
- **Inputs:** web forms through oRPC procedures inside `withUser`; `v_listings`; `v_profiles` (account age); `isActive()`; `account.deleted`.
- **Outputs:** `seller-reply-reports.recorded` (listing IDs); `erase(listingIds)`.
- **Owns:** `reports` (listing, reporter_user_id, code, at; unique on listing, reporter and code). Row-level security on the reporter's user ID.
- **Views:** internal `v_counts` (listing_id, code, reporters, established_reporters). User-facing: none.
- **Contracts:** `SellerReplyReportsCode`, `SellerReplyReportsInput`, `SellerReplyReportsRecordedEvent`.
- **Depends on:** `switches`, `auth`, `account`, `listing-ingest`.
- **When off:** no reports are taken; the "too good to be true" mark rests on listing signals alone.
- **Tests and fixtures:** a second identical report writes nothing; no reporter ID in any view; purge on `account.deleted`; the rate limit.
- **Priority and phase:** MVP (`nabvy/docs/decisions.md:154-158`); shown only through `suspected-labels`, after legal review of the wording (`nabvy/docs/legal-review.md:30,39`).
- **Sources:** `nabvy/docs/decisions.md:154-166`; `actor-integration.md` section 8, change 9.
- **Open questions:** 16, 43.
